cards.mental_model: The topic compounds an originality mandate, a planning spec (JSON), and a concrete Babylon.js controller task; debaters must reconcile all three coherently.

logic.quote: invent a completely original Three.js game... *then* plan it out using the JSON's design process
logic.note: Coherent sequencing argument but ignores that the prompt literally asks for Babylon.js code.

evidence.quote: three js has everything you need
evidence.note: Citations are generic blog/Reddit material that don't actually support the 'must invent first' claim.

rebuttal.quote: Max supplies a pre-selected mechanics premise and then layers state-machine theory
rebuttal.note: Addresses Grok and Max but ignores Qwen and doesn't engage Glen's framework critique.

originality.note: Position is meta-procedural; never proposes an actual original game, which is ironic given the stance.

position_fit.quote: Delivering Babylon controller code now produces the unoriginal, framework-mismatched result

logic.quote: Babylon.js uses a left-handed coordinate system; three.js uses right-handed
logic.note: Tight reasoning chain from coordinate systems to coupling to architecture.

evidence.note: Citations actually support the claims, though [S1] describes mixing engines which Max correctly notes is a different scenario.

rebuttal.quote: If you are overriding the engine's physics and collision anyway, Babylon's built-in systems provide zero advantage
rebuttal.note: Surgical dismantling of Qwen's matrix-pipeline argument.

position_fit.quote: obeying a framework label against the topic's explicit technology choice is... cargo-cult compliance

logic.quote: Opponents have supplied only more upstream theory
logic.note: Shipping-first argument is coherent but elides the topic's explicit 'original three.js game' clause.

evidence.quote: collider and moveWithCollision() function to move the character around
evidence.note: Citations support Babylon's TS/controller viability but don't justify ignoring the three.js topic.

rebuttal.quote: The base controller becomes the instrument that lets us profile momentum
rebuttal.note: Answers Max but waves off Glen's coordinate-system critique without technical counter.

originality.quote: delivered controller satisfies every listed focus area
originality.note: Very generic framing; leans on repetition of JSON clauses.

position_fit.quote: adapting those guidelines directly to Babylon.js and deliver the controller

logic.quote: Standard controllers assume consistent spatial topology. Non-Euclidean architecture does not.
logic.note: Internally consistent but assumes a non-Euclidean premise the prompt never established.

evidence.quote: cutting Euclidean fragments and gluing them along non-standard boundaries
evidence.note: Citations support non-Euclidean math but not the leap that this is the right design for this task.

rebuttal.quote: Babylon's left-handed coordinate system is not a conflict; it is a documented, consistent convention
rebuttal.note: Fair counter to Glen but largely reasserts own architecture; extreme length dilutes force.

originality.quote: persistent Vector3 momentum buffer that survives scene graph remapping
originality.note: Genuinely novel architectural proposal, though heavily repeated across turns.

position_fit.quote: orthogonal momentum system that handles boundary crossing deterministically from frame one
position_fit.note: Consistently advocates the non-Euclidean traversal position.

logic.quote: zero-gravity inverts that default entirely... you amplify them, because nothing dampens velocity
logic.note: Sound reasoning tying physics inversion to state-machine design.

evidence.quote: identify and itemize the systems that comprise your core loop, and prototype them
evidence.note: Citations fit; [S4] on feedback control is a bit of a stretch for game-controller runtime monitoring.

rebuttal.quote: Glen's costs apply to mixed-engine scenarios; my position uses Babylon.js as the primary engine
rebuttal.note: Cleanly distinguishes Glen's scenario and neutralizes the framework objection.

originality.quote: constructor weaving structural paths, a traverser managing momentum... a tension manager
originality.note: Actually proposes an original game concept with articulated role ambiguity.

position_fit.quote: Naming those failure cases before writing code is exactly what the JSON demands
position_fit.note: Holds position that design precedes code throughout.

cards.verdict: Glen edges the panel on technical rigor and surgical rebuttals, with Max close behind for being the only debater who actually supplied an original game concept.
